title: S1 freeze: assemble CONTRACT.md + contract.json and freeze them before any S2 test
objective: Assemble drafts A and B into the versioned S1 contract with the approved caps, custody declaration and challenge minimums, validate it, and commit the freeze before any S2 implementation test is written.
problem: Plan s2 S1 exit: a versioned claim/reset/interface table, exact domain, expected outcomes, source/exposure record, trust boundary and approved absolute caps, committed before testing the new implementation. Plan s5: S1 freezes the challenge minimum coverage (S3: 5 fresh sound, 5 fresh broken, 10 distinct applicable semantic edits spanning reset/observer, binding and invalidation; S4: 2, 2, 3) and reviewer ownership, not attack contents. Closure C1-C5 written in. Custody: copy C-004-OP2's ruling if decided, else 'keeper NONE; custody UNQUALIFIED'. Caps: copy C-004-OP1's ruling. Reviewer: copy C-004-OP3's ruling if decided, else 'per C-004-OP3, pending'. Freeze = CONTRACT.md and contract.json committed with contract.json frozen: true and a sha256 manifest (python -m comms.manifest write rso/slice001/contract/).
non_goals: No redesign of the RSO and no reopening of the closed design review (CLOSURE_REVIEW_v0.4 G)
No change to the contract after freeze except a versioned amendment recorded beside the original (base doctrine: corrections are annotations)
evidence_required: `python -B -m rso.slice001.ci` reports contract.json present and shape-valid
a coverage check: every plan s3 item, C1-C5, T01-T08, E01-E06 appears in contract.json cases or fields
MANIFEST.md beside the contract verifies (python -m comms.manifest verify rso/slice001/contract/)
